items.title: ozzy - design engineer intro with highlighted keywords
items.description: A portfolio intro: 'hello, i'm ozzy. two years as a frontend engineer, then the design side won. now i'm a design engineer at soft machine...' with highlighted links (interior[.]dev, behindyou, inspiration, writing, x, github) beside a rail of project cards. A text-led designer bio.

items.title: Syncraft - 'Crafting ideas in sync.' with a line-drawn village
items.description: A white landing for Syncraft: 'Crafting ideas in sync.' with Japanese subcopy, a single-line landscape (house, bridge, tree, tiny figures) and WORKS/NOTES/CONTACT/日本語 nav, plus 'tap to jump' hints. A playful studio landing.

items.title: Knowledge Base Editor - palm hero and beta checklist
items.description: A cream editor page: 'Knowledge Base - Editor' under a painted palm, copy about a multiplayer editor, a 'Beta checklist' (finish mobile, test all systems go, finish the website) and a bottom toolbar (Expand Selection, Web Link, Bold, Italic). A cozy editor demo.

items.title: Design tool panel - Boards and Layers over a dot canvas
items.description: A floating white panel on a pink-orange gradient: window dots, 'My Proj... / Board 1 - Frame 1' header, Boards search/+ and a Layers tree (Frame 1, Page 1) over a dotted canvas. A design-tool chrome study.

items.title: 'designer. artist. human.' - anurag's pixel-art portfolio
items.description: A phone portfolio: 'designer. artist. human. - I'm anurag. i ask, i explore, i tinker — designing to make technology feel more human.' with a pink pixel-art face and 'currently at Bored... face dead - 96x96'. A compact artist bio.

items.title: Codex terminal on a laptop with a round face robot
items.description: A laptop screen: Codex CLI lines ('Hello / Hello! 👋', 'Make the sleep timing faster', 'Working (5s - esc to interrupt)', 'Ask Codex to do anything', gpt-5.6-sol medium fast) beside a round robot device showing a cute face. A coding-agent hardware moment.

items.title: Xcode hot-reload - SwiftUI source beside an iPhone 18 Pro preview
items.description: An Xcode window editing ContentView.swift (struct ContentView: View, @State private var signed, Image 'signature', Button 'Sign') beside an iPhone 18 Pro simulator preview updating live. An Xcode hot-reload demo, not VS Code.

items.title: Dark note wall - 'add your note' modal with paper colors
items.description: A dark notes site ('the thoug...') behind an 'add your note' modal: taped paper preview, PAPER COLOR dots, font swatches (Printed, Gingham...), 'YOUR NOTE - message someone when you mi...', name/handle field and Submit. A public note composer.

items.title: Pratham Yadav - pixel wordmark, dot field and 'hi' cursor
items.description: A portfolio: pixel 'PRATHAM' wordmark, Projects/Contact, Search ⌘K and sound/theme toggles; a dot field with a cursor 'hi' bubble; 'Pratham Yadav - Product & Design Engineer' with Book a call / Send an email. A friendly engineer portfolio.
